body_markdown:
When you're looking for a baby monitor, there's no shortage of options out there, and most of them focus on one thing: video.[Dream Sight™](https://owletcare.com/products/dream-sight?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=dreamsight) was designed to offer


more


, combining 2K HD video with built-in cry, sound, and motion detection, along with real-time room temperature and humidity tracking. Dream Sight gives parents a fuller picture of what's happening in the nursery, not just a view of it. Here are five things about Dream Sight that most parents don't know, plus the new accessory everyone has been asking for.


### **1. It's the only baby monitor with the SGS Cybersecurity Mark**


Baby monitors connect on your home WiFi, which means security is not simply a nice-to-have, it's essential. Dream Sight is protected by 256-bit encryption and elliptic curve authentication, and it's independently verified with the


[SGS Cybersecurity Mark](https://www.sgs.com/en/news/2025/10/sgs-cybersecurity-mark-presented-to-owlet-dream-sight-the-first-for-a-baby-monitor) , a distinction no other baby monitor on the market currently holds. In practical terms, this means your video feed stays private and secure, giving you one less thing to worry about.


### **2. It pairs with our new Floor Stand, so no wall mounting is required**


This is the update parents have been waiting for. Our new[Dream Sight™ Floor Stand](https://owletcare.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=FloorStand) offers a flexible way to position your camera exactly where you want it, without drilling into a wall. It's an easier setup for renters, shared rooms, or any parent who would rather avoid another hole in the nursery wall. It pairs with your Dream Sight camera to deliver the same 2K clarity, with far more flexibility when it comes to placement.


### **3. It tracks more than just video**


Dream Sight is designed to capture a more complete view of your baby’s sleep environment, not just footage. Built-in sound, motion, and cry detection notify you the moment something needs attention, while temperature and humidity sensors keep tabs on the nursery environment itself. If the room runs too warm or the air gets dry, you'll be able to stay informed and on top of helping your baby sleep comfortably.


### **4. It can play white noise directly through the camera**


For families using the Owlet360™ experience, Dream Sight also functions as a sound machine. White noise can be streamed directly through the camera speaker from the app, which means one less device in the nursery and one more reason the camera earns its place in the nursery.


### **5. It pairs with Dream Sock for a more complete picture of your baby’s sleep and safety**


Dream Sight shows you what's happening in the room, but it can't tell you how your baby is actually doing. That's where[Dream Sock®](https://www.owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sock?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=DreamSock) comes in. Dream Sight is a fully capable video monitor on its own, with no additional Owlet devices required. For parents who want video and health tracking in one place, it pairs seamlessly with our FDA-cleared Dream Sock. Together, they bring pulse rate, oxygen level, and sleep trends together with live 2K video, all within the same Owlet Dream App.


****


The takeaway:


Dream Sight is Owlet's most advanced and accessible camera. With the new Floor Stand for easier setup, smart notifications, environmental monitoring, and the option to pair it with Dream Sock for deeper health insights, it's designed to fit into every nursery.


Ready to see it in action? Shop[Dream Sight](https://owletcare.com/products/dream-sight?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=dreamsight) and the new[Floor Stand](https://owletcare.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=FloorStand) →


****


*As a reminder, Dream Sock is intended to track babies' pulse rate and oxygen level and keep parents informed, but it is not intended to diagnose, treat or cure any disease or other condition including, but not limited to, Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS) and/or Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV).*
